text: DHL: Your parcel is on hold. Pay the $1.99 fee within 24 hours or it will be returned. Pay now: dhl-fee-pay.xyz/track
tell: A fee plus a deadline in hours is a pressure trick, and dhl-fee-pay.xyz is not DHL.
action: Ignore it. If you expect a parcel, open the courier's real website yourself.

text: Your electricity will be cut off today at 5pm unless your overdue bill is paid. Call 0800-555-0199 immediately to avoid disconnection. Do not ignore this notice.
tell: Real utility companies send warnings by letter and give you time. A deadline today is pressure.
action: Don't call. Check your bill and call the number printed on it.

text: This is Officer Daniels from the Cyber Crime Unit. Your name appeared in a fraud case. Stay on the line and do not tell your bank or family. We will guide you.
tell_phrase: do not tell your bank or family
tell: Real police never ask you to keep it secret from your bank or family.
action: Hang up. Call your local police on a number you look up yourself.

text: Message from your bank's security team: We froze your account after suspicious activity. To unfreeze it, move your savings to the safe account we give you now.
tell_phrase: move your savings to the safe account
tell: A bank never asks you to move your money to a 'safe account'. That account belongs to the scammer.
action: Don't move any money. Call the number on the back of your bank card.

text: Security alert: someone tried to sign in to your account. We just texted you a 6-digit code. Reply with that code to cancel the sign-in.
tell: The code that was texted to you is the key to your account. Nobody real asks you to send it back.
action: Never share the code. Change your password on the official app or website.

text: Hi, I'm interested in the sofa you're selling, but my buyer protection needs a check. I'm sending you a code by text, please read it to me so I can verify you're real.
tell: A buyer never needs a code sent to your phone. They are using it to take over your account.
action: Don't share the code. Block the buyer and report them to the marketplace.

text: Hi grandma it's me, I'm in trouble and need cash. Please buy four $100 gift cards and send me the numbers on the back. Don't tell Mom.
tell_phrase: send me the numbers on the back
tell: Gift card numbers are like cash. Asking you to keep it secret is a big warning.
action: Call your grandchild on the number you already have. Don't buy any gift cards.

text: To release your prize, pay the $250 tax by buying a Bitcoin voucher at any kiosk and sending us the code.
tell: Real prizes never ask you to pay with vouchers or crypto first.
action: Ignore it. You can't win a contest you never entered.

text: Netflix: your payment failed. Update your billing details to keep watching: netflix-billing-help.top/login
tell: The address ends in .top and has extra words. The real Netflix address ends in netflix.com.
action: Don't tap it. Open the Netflix app or type netflix.com yourself.

text: Amazon: We noticed a login from a new device. If this wasn't you, secure your account here: amaz0n-security.click/verify. Thanks, Amazon Support
tell: Look closely: 'amaz0n' has a zero instead of an o, and the ending is .click.
action: Don't tap it. Open the Amazon app yourself to check your account.

text: Congratulations! You've been selected to win a new phone in our loyalty draw. You only need to answer 3 questions and pay $4.95 shipping. Claim here: bit.ly/win-phone16
tell: You didn't enter, and the 'shipping fee' is how they get your card details.
action: Ignore it. Never pay to claim a prize.

text: Earn $400 a day from your phone with no experience. Guaranteed returns, no risk. Limited spots, message me on Telegram to start.
tell: Nothing is guaranteed and risk-free. Easy money is the bait.
action: Don't reply. Real work doesn't recruit by unknown text.

text: Mum, my phone broke so I'm using a friend's. I'm stuck abroad and my wallet was stolen. Can you transfer $800 right now? I'll explain later, please don't call.
tell: A real child in trouble would take your call. 'Don't call' keeps you from checking.
action: Call your child's old number, or someone who is with them, before sending anything.

text: I know we've only talked online for 3 weeks but I feel like I've known you forever. My shipment is stuck at customs and I need $1,200 to release it. I love you.
tell: Someone you have never met asking for money is a romance scam, however kind they seem.
action: Stop sending money. Talk to a friend or family member you trust.

text: Microsoft Support: Your computer has a virus. Call us now and install AnyDesk so our technician can remove it for free.
tell: Real support never contacts you first. Giving remote access lets them see everything.
action: Don't call or install anything. Close the page. If a window won't close, restart the computer.

text: We accidentally refunded you $3,000 instead of $300. Please install QuickSupport so we can reverse the extra amount. Do not close your screen.
tell: Refunds don't need remote control of your computer. This is a trick to reach your bank.
action: Don't install anything. Call your bank using the number on your card.

text: I am a lawyer representing the estate of a late relative of yours who left $4.5 million. To release the funds, you need to pay a $900 legal processing fee first.
tell_phrase: pay a $900 legal processing fee first
tell: Real inheritances don't ask you to pay before you get the money.
action: Delete it. No stranger is leaving you millions.

text: Your loan of $10,000 is approved! No credit check. Just send a $150 insurance deposit and the money will arrive today.
tell: Real lenders take fees out of the loan. They never ask you to pay first.
action: Don't send anything. Apply only with a lender you can look up.

text: IRS Notice: You have an unpaid tax balance. A warrant will be issued unless you pay today by gift card. Case #44821.
tell: Tax offices never accept gift cards and never threaten arrest by text.
action: Ignore it. Check your tax account on the official government website.

text: Medicare: Your new card is ready. Confirm your Medicare number and date of birth at the link to avoid losing coverage: medicare-card-update.info
tell: Health services don't text you links to 'confirm' your details. .info is not an official ending.
action: Don't tap it. Call the number on your current card.

text: Hi, I saw your profile. My uncle's team posts trading signals with 300% monthly returns. Join our private group and deposit with USDT to start.
tell: No honest investment makes 300% a month. High returns plus a rush to deposit is the trap.
action: Don't deposit. Ask a trusted family member or a licensed adviser.

text: Your crypto account balance shows $12,400 profit! To withdraw it you must first pay a 10% release fee. Add funds to unlock withdrawal.
tell: Fake sites show fake profits, then ask for a fee to withdraw. The money isn't real.
action: Stop adding money. Contact your bank and a trusted adviser.

text: We're hiring! Boost app ratings and earn $30 per task, 20 minutes a day. First, deposit $50 to activate your work account, refunded with your first payout.
tell_phrase: deposit $50 to activate your work account
tell: A real job pays you. It never asks you to pay in first.
action: Don't reply. Block the sender.

text: Part-time job: like videos and get paid. Complete 40 tasks to unlock your commission. Some premium tasks need you to top up your balance first.
tell: Being asked to top up your balance means you are paying them.
action: Walk away. Don't put money into any job account.

text: Hi, this is Dr. Lee's clinic. Reminder: your appointment is tomorrow at 10:30am. Reply C to confirm or call us on the number on your appointment card to reschedule.
tell: Nothing here asks for money, codes or a rush. If unsure, contact them on a number you already know.
action: It's fine, but you can always call the clinic yourself.

text: Your library hold is ready for pickup at the front desk until Friday. Bring your library card.
tell: Nothing here asks for money, codes or a rush. If unsure, contact them on a number you already know.
action: Fine to follow. Bring your card.

text: Mom, running 10 minutes late, please start dinner without me. Love you!
tell: Nothing here asks for money, codes or a rush. If unsure, contact them on a number you already know.
action: No action needed.

text: Your bank: a new statement is ready. Sign in through our official app to view it. We will never ask for your PIN or full password.
tell: It points you to the official app and asks for nothing. Even so, never tap links in texts about money.
action: Open your bank's app yourself.

text: Hi, it's Sam from the soccer club. Practice moved to Saturday 9am at the north field. Bring water.
tell: Nothing here asks for money, codes or a rush. If unsure, contact them on a number you already know.
action: No action needed.

text: Your verification code is 482913. Don't share it with anyone. If you didn't request it, ignore this message.
tell: It only gives you a code you asked for. It doesn't ask you to send it anywhere.
action: Use it only if YOU just asked for it. Otherwise ignore it.

text: Your parcel could not be delivered. Confirm your address and pay a $2 redelivery fee in the next 12 hours: post-redeliver.top/confirm
tell: A tiny fee plus a short deadline is the trick. The address ends in .top, not a real courier.
action: Ignore it. Track your parcel on the courier's real website.

text: Your account will be closed in 2 hours. Verify now or lose access to your savings. This is your last warning.
tell: Real banks don't give 'last warnings' by text, and they never close accounts in hours.
action: Don't reply. Open your bank's app yourself, or call the number on your card.

text: Hello, this is Detective Marsh from the Financial Crimes Unit. A warrant has been issued in your name. To clear it, buy prepaid cards and read us the numbers.
tell_phrase: buy prepaid cards and read us the numbers
tell: Police never take payment in prepaid cards. That is how scammers get paid.
action: Hang up. Call your local police on a number you look up yourself.

text: We have detected a sign-in to your email from another country. To block it, tell us the one-time password we just sent you.
tell: The one-time password is for you alone. Anyone asking for it wants into your account.
action: Never share it. Change your password on the official site.

text: Congratulations, your number won our monthly draw! To receive $2,000, first send a $40 courier fee through a Bitcoin machine.
tell_phrase: send a $40 courier fee through a Bitcoin machine
tell: You can't win a draw you didn't enter, and real prizes never need a fee.
action: Ignore it. Never pay to collect a prize.

text: Hi Nan, I'm at the airport and my card was declined. Please wire $600 to my friend right now and don't tell Mum, I'll explain later.
tell: Asking you to keep it secret stops you from checking. It is a classic family-emergency scam.
action: Phone your grandchild on the number you already have before sending anything.

text: Your PC is sending us error codes. Open the link and run the support tool so our agent can connect to your screen and clean it.
tell: Real tech support never contacts you first or asks to control your screen.
action: Close it and don't run anything. Turn off the computer's internet if you did.

text: Dear friend, I have inherited funds and need a trustworthy partner abroad. Pay a $350 transfer tax and you will receive 30% of $6 million.
tell: Real inheritances don't ask a stranger to pay a tax first.
action: Delete it. No stranger is sharing millions with you.

text: Tax Office: you are owed a refund of $614. Claim it at gov-refund-claim.info within 48 hours or it will be cancelled.
tell: Government websites end in .gov, not .info. A refund link with a deadline is a classic trick.
action: Don't tap it. Log in to the real tax website by typing the address yourself.

text: A friend of mine made 40% in a week with this crypto group. Join today and send USDT to start, spots are limited.
tell: Big fast returns plus pressure to deposit is how fake investment groups work.
action: Don't send money. Talk to someone you trust and check the company is registered.

text: Remote data entry job, $25 per task, 30 minutes a day. Recharge $80 into your work wallet to unlock higher paying tasks.
tell: A job that makes you put money in is taking your money, not paying you.
action: Don't reply. Block the sender.

text: Security notice: your PayPal account is limited. Restore access at paypa1-resolution.com and confirm your password to avoid closure.
tell: 'paypa1' has a number 1 instead of the letter l. The real address is paypal.com.
action: Don't tap it. Open the PayPal app yourself.
